timeline.title: PSC rank lists expiring by August 31 extended to November 30
timeline.summary: The second Cabinet decided to extend expiring PSC rank lists by three months because appointments were delayed during the election period. The broader promise of a new PSC law, better vacancy reporting, and completing recruitment before lists expire remains pending.

timeline.title: Kerala PSC extends rank-list validity to November 30

promise_en: scheme will be devised to help women after the age of 35 who want to work from home to get part-time jobs. A skill development platform (digital marketing, digital content creation, digital art, toy making, cooking courses etc.) will be implemented for women who want to work from home. The MAMA Action Plan will be implemented in an integrated manner as possible to ensure marketability of products along with skill development.

promise_en: Receiving the development fund announced in the budget will be made a right of local self-government institutions. Instead of allocating development funds only on the basis of plan outlay, a fixed percentage of the state's own tax revenue will be assigned and given to local bodies at regular, time-bound intervals.
promise_ml: ബജറ്റില്‍ പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ച വികസനഫണ്ട്‌ ലഭിക്കുക എന്നത്‌ തദ്ദേശസ്വയംഭരണ സ്ഥാപനങ്ങളുടെ അവകാശമാക്കുന്നതാണ്‌. സംസ്ഥാനത്ത്‌ നിലവില്‍ വികസന ഫണ്ട്‌ നല്‍കുന്നത്‌ പദ്ധതി അടങ്കലിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനത്തിലാണ്‌. ഇതില്‍ മാറ്റം വരുത്തുന്നതിനായി സംസ്ഥാനത്തെ തനത്‌ നികുതി വരുമാനത്തില്‍ നിന്നും നിശ്ചിത ശതമാനം നിശ്ചയിച്ച്‌ തദ്ദേശസ്വയംഭരണ സ്ഥാപനങ്ങള്‍ക്ക്‌ നൽകും. ഇത്‌ കൃത്യമായ
simple_explanation: The manifesto commits to making budgeted development funds a right of local self-government institutions. It also promises a fixed share of state own-tax revenue to local bodies at regular intervals.
why_it_matters: This matters because predictable funding affects whether local bodies can deliver roads, services, welfare projects, and local development on time.
if_not_done: If it is not fulfilled, local bodies may continue to face delayed or uncertain development funding.

timeline.event: Cabinet officially approved free KSRTC travel for all women in Kerala.
Implementation date set: Free travel for women on all KSRTC buses starts June 15, 2026.

promise_en: Women will be given free travel in KSRTC buses.
promise_ml: സ്ത്രീകൾക്ക് കെ.എസ്.ആർ.ടി.സി ബസ്സുകളിൽ സൗജന്യ യാത്ര
simple_explanation: The manifesto promises free travel for women in KSRTC buses. This would reduce daily travel costs for women who rely on public transport.
why_it_matters: This matters to women commuters, students, workers, and families because bus fares affect daily mobility and household expenses.
if_not_done: If it is not fulfilled, women who depend on public transport will not receive the promised fare relief.

timeline.event: Rs. 1,000/month financial assistance for college girl students announced as Indira Guarantee #2 on Day 1 of the Satheesan cabinet.

promise_en: College girl students will receive Rs. 1,000 in monthly financial assistance.
promise_ml: കോളേജ് വിദ്യാർത്ഥിനികൾക്ക് പ്രതിമാസം 1000 രൂപ ധനസഹായം
simple_explanation: The manifesto promises Rs. 1,000 per month as financial assistance for college girl students. This is tracked as a student-support commitment.
why_it_matters: This matters to women students and families that face recurring education and travel expenses.
if_not_done: If it is not fulfilled, eligible college students will miss the promised monthly support.

timeline.event: Oommen Chandy Health Insurance Scheme (up to Rs. 25 lakh per family) announced as Indira Guarantee #3 on Day 1 cabinet meeting.

promise_en: All families will receive free Oommen Chandy Health Insurance coverage up to Rs. 25,00,000.
promise_ml: ഉമ്മൻ ചാണ്ടി ആരോഗ്യ ഇൻഷുറൻസ് എല്ലാ കുടുംബങ്ങൾക്കും 25,00,000 രൂപ വരെയുള്ള സൗജന്യ ആരോഗ്യ ഇൻഷുറൻസ് പരിരക്ഷ
simple_explanation: The manifesto promises free Oommen Chandy Health Insurance coverage up to Rs. 25 lakh for all families. This is a major healthcare-cost protection commitment.
why_it_matters: This matters to households facing hospital bills, major illnesses, and unexpected medical expenses.
if_not_done: If it is not fulfilled, families may continue to face high out-of-pocket medical costs without the promised insurance protection.

timeline.event: Interest-free loans up to Rs. 5 lakh for youth entrepreneurship announced as Indira Guarantee #5 on Day 1 cabinet meeting.

promise_en: Youth will receive interest-free loans up to Rs. 5,00,000 to start businesses.
promise_ml: യുവ ജനങ്ങൾക്ക് ബിസിനസുകൾ ആരംഭിക്കുന്നതിന് 5 ലക്ഷം രൂപ വരെ പലിശരഹിത വായ്പ
simple_explanation: The manifesto promises interest-free loans up to Rs. 5 lakh for young people starting businesses. This is tracked as a youth entrepreneurship commitment.
why_it_matters: This matters to young entrepreneurs who need affordable capital to start small businesses.
if_not_done: If it is not fulfilled, young people may lose the promised low-cost route to start enterprises.

timeline.event: A separate department exclusively for the welfare of senior citizens announced — CM Satheesan said it will be the first such dedicated department in any Indian state. Setup in progress.

timeline.title: Senior Citizen Welfare Department constituted by government order
timeline.summary: Government of Kerala issued G.O.(Ms) No.63/2026/GAD constituting a Senior Citizen Welfare Department for formulating new schemes and coordinating existing schemes for elderly welfare.
timeline.source_title: Government of Kerala: G.O.(Ms) No.63/2026/GAD constituting Senior Citizen Welfare Department

promise_en: A special department will be created for the welfare of senior citizens.
promise_ml: മുതിർന്ന പൗരന്മാർക്ക് ക്ഷേമത്തിനായി പ്രത്യേക വകുപ്പ്
simple_explanation: The manifesto promises a dedicated department for senior citizen welfare. This would create a specific administrative owner for elderly care policy.
why_it_matters: This matters to senior citizens and families because elderly welfare often needs focused health, care, and social-support systems.
if_not_done: If it is not fulfilled, elderly welfare may remain split across departments without the promised dedicated focus.

promise_en: Project Menstrual Dignity will provide up to three days of monthly menstrual leave for schoolgirls, with weekend catch-up classes so students do not fall behind.
simple_explanation: The government announced Project Menstrual Dignity in the May 29, 2026 policy address. It is tracked as a post-manifesto government commitment because no exact manifesto promise ID was found for menstrual leave.
why_it_matters: This affects school-going girls and menstrual health access in educational institutions.
if_not_done: If not implemented, the announced menstrual-health support for schoolgirls may remain only a policy-address commitment.

simple_explanation: This is a post-manifesto government commitment from the May 29, 2026 policy address and is tracked because no exact manifesto record was found.
why_it_matters: Childcare access can affect women workers, parents and workplace participation.
if_not_done: If not implemented, the announced workplace childcare support may not reach employees and families.

simple_explanation: This policy-address commitment is tracked as a post-manifesto government action because no exact manifesto promise ID was found.
why_it_matters: It affects children without stable family support and the state child welfare system.
if_not_done: If not implemented, the announced orphan-free Kerala initiative may not translate into support systems for vulnerable children.

timeline.summary: The policy address announced adoption campaigns and a network of trained foster families under the Juvenile Justice Act.
